evidence.quote:
requires a signed release
manifest before it ships
that is the whole reason for the gate

observations.why: Quinton frames the gate as protecting the collective from past harm — security and benefit to others co-occur.
The gate is asserted as a security requirement — conservation of stability through mandated process.
Extending the gate across all environments appeals to comprehensive security coverage.
Naming an owner stabilizes accountability — conservation of order through assigned responsibility.

mints.name: GateAsCollectiveSafeguard
mints.title: a gate whose reason is protecting the whole from past harm
mints.frame: Is the control here motivated by preventing recurrence of harm to the collective, not by individual preference?
